answer_1.quote: Non-autoregressive text to speech (NAR-TTS) models have shown much faster inference speed than their autoregressive counterparts, while achieving comparable or even better voice quality.

answer_2.quote: To measure the degree of over-smoothness of mel-spectrograms objectively, we calculate the variation of the Laplacian (Var L ) on the generated mel-spectrograms

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the voice quality of the synthesized speech subjectively, we conduct the MOS (Loizou, 2011) tests. Twenty native English speakers are asked to make quality judgments about the synthesized speech samples.
answer_4.guideline: For MOS, each evaluator is asked to mark the subjective naturalness of a sentence on a 1-5 Likert scale. For CMOS, listeners are asked to compare pairs of audio generated by systems A and B and indicate which of the two audio they prefer.
